<h1>Jake Diamond</h1>
<div class="home-top">
<div>
<p class="hello">Greetings!</p>
<p>Hope you are well reading this. My name is Jake and I work on water quality and ecohydrology.</p>
<p>I am now a <strong>Programme Specialist for Water Quality and Ecohydrology at UNESCO</strong>, in Paris.</p>
<p>My background is in environmental data science, hydrology, ecosystem ecology, and biogeochemistry. This website has some of my research, figures, and publications.</p>
<p><a href="about.html">More about me</a> · <a href="mailto:diamondjacob@gmail.com">Get in touch</a></p>
</div>

<p>I'm interested in questions like:</p>
<ol class="questions">
<li>How do ecosystems <a href="research.html#anchormicro">self-organize</a>?</li>
<li>What can emergent properties of ecosystems tell us about their <a href="research.html#anchorbgc">internal processes</a>?</li>
<li>How can we use our understanding of ecosystems to improve <a href="research.html#anchorriveco">resource management and human health</a>?</li>
</ol>
